raw.markdown:
# Peyronie's Disease Surgery — Authorization Guide

_Subtitle: CPT Codes · ICD-10 · Payer Requirements_

backHref: /peyronies

## CPT Codes

| CPT | Description | Procedure Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 54110 | Excision of penile plaque (Peyronie's disease) | Plaque excision |
| 54111 | Excision of penile plaque (Peyronie's disease); with graft to 5 sq cm | Grafting ≤5 cm² |
| 54112 | Excision of penile plaque (Peyronie's disease); with graft greater than 5 sq cm | Grafting >5 cm² |
| 54360 | Plastic operation on penis to correct angulation | Plication (Nesbit) |
| 54400 | Insertion of penile prosthesis; non-inflatable (semi-rigid) | IPP — semi-rigid |
| 54405 | Insertion of multi-component inflatable penile prosthesis | IPP — inflatable |
| 54406 | Removal of all components of a multi-component inflatable penile prosthesis without replacement | IPP removal |
| 54408 | Repair of component(s) of a multi-component inflatable penile prosthesis | IPP repair |
| J0775 | Collagenase clostridium histolyticum injection, 0.01 mg (Xiaflex) | Non-surgical injection |

## ICD-10 Diagnoses

| ICD-10 | Description |
| --- | --- |
| N48.6 | Induration penis plastica (Peyronie's disease) |
| N52.01 | Erectile dysfunction due to arterial insufficiency |
| N52.02 | Corporo-venous occlusive erectile dysfunction |
| N52.03 | Combined arterial insufficiency and corporo-venous occlusive erectile dysfunction |
| N52.1 | Erectile dysfunction due to diseases classified elsewhere |
| N52.9 | Male erectile dysfunction, unspecified |
| N48.89 | Other specified disorders of penis |

## Coverage Landscape

### Common Denial Reasons

- "Cosmetic procedure" (incorrect — Peyronie's is a medical condition)
- "Not medically necessary" without documentation of functional impairment
- Collagenase (Xiaflex) denied as "experimental" or "not covered"
- Penile prosthesis denied when ED is the primary indication

### Strongest Coverage Arguments

- N48.6 (Peyronie's disease) is a distinct medical diagnosis, not cosmetic
- Functional impairment: inability to engage in sexual intercourse (N52.x)
- AUA Guideline (2015) provides evidence-based surgical recommendations
- Collagenase (Xiaflex) is FDA-approved for Peyronie's disease (2013)
- Penile prosthesis for combined PD + severe ED treats two medical conditions simultaneously

## Prior Authorization Requirements

### Required Documentation

- Clinical diagnosis of Peyronie's disease (N48.6) with duration documented
- Curvature angle measurement (pharmacologically induced erection or vacuum device)
- Documentation of stable disease ≥12 months (no change in curvature)
- Erectile function assessment (IIEF-5 score, PDE5i response)
- Penile duplex Doppler ultrasound (if vascular ED suspected)
- Documentation of functional impairment (inability to have intercourse)
- Prior non-surgical treatment attempts (collagenase, traction, oral agents)
- Letter of medical necessity from urologist

### AUA Surgical Criteria

- Stable disease ≥12 months (no change in curvature, pain resolution)
- Curvature ≥30° causing inability to have intercourse
- Adequate erectile function (or IPP if severe ED)
- Patient desire for surgical correction after counseling
- Partner counseled and involved in decision-making
